issues.legal_issue: The interim moratorium under Section 96 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code does not stay enforcement proceedings under Section 27 of the Consumer Protection Act for regulatory penalties imposed for non-compliance with consumer protection orders.
Regulatory penalties and damages arising from consumer protection violations are not debts covered by the moratorium under Section 96 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
Proceedings under Section 27 of the Consumer Protection Act are distinct from proceedings under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act for purposes of an insolvency moratorium.
